title: Used-Accessory Withholding on PAP Therapy Equipment Refunds
content:
# Used-Accessory Withholding on PAP Therapy Equipment Refunds

**Refund terms.** The amount withheld from the refund of a self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit for its accessories follows the return inspection:

- when the return inspection on the device record shows a used-accessory amount **above the standard accessory kit of 104.00 USD**, that amount is withheld;
- when it shows **no used-accessory amount at all**, the accessories came back sealed and nothing is withheld;
- in any other case — an amount above zero up to the standard kit, or no used-accessory amount recorded on the device record — the standard kit of **104.00 USD** is withheld as the minimum charge for opened accessories.

**Where it is read.** The return inspection is the inspection job in the device's service history that carries no repair cost assignment; the used-accessory amount is the amount of used accessories the patient bears recorded on it. An inspection whose used-accessory amount is 0.00 shows no used-accessory amount at all. A device record with no such inspection has no used-accessory amount recorded.

## Input — judgement — output

| Return inspection on the record | Used-accessory amount on it | Withheld (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 0.00 | 0.00 (sealed accessories) |
| yes | above 0.00 and up to 104.00 | 104.00 |
| yes | above 104.00 | the recorded amount |
| no | — | 104.00 |

**Cases (hypothetical amounts).** Recorded 94.00: 104.00 withheld. Recorded 104.00: 104.00 withheld. Recorded 140.50: 140.50 withheld. Recorded 0.00: nothing withheld.
